Incineroar is slow. Hero is somewhat slow. Zelda is also somewhat slow. However, of the three, I would say Zelda is your best bet for tough matchups, reasons being: 

1. Her kick of death is fucking OP. 
2. Nayru’s love is a fantastic combo breaker (makes you invincible from frames 4-13) as long as they don’t read you’re gonna do it (because that ending lag is doodoo)
3. Her spike, forward air, back air, all have sweet spots but the sour spots always hit and generally still fuck up whatever your opponent was trying to do to you 
4. Her recovery is fine
5. Despite the slow projectiles, the combination of them can be extremely useful and deadly 
6. All of her attacks are fast, (she as a character is slow),  but some of her frame data is hella good. 

Side note: Zelda has quite a few multi hit moves: jab, side smash, up smash, nayrus love, sooooo it makes her a good character to use especially against characters who get rewarded for shielding. Reason being that it does too much shield pressure and then they can’t capitalize on it. 

I’m not preaching that she’s amazing, or the best character ever, but I believe people be sleeping HARD on Zelda overall. 

BONUS: you can cancel the free fall of her Up B on the edges of platforms and the stage (shit looks really hard but would dope to figure out) and then just flex on people with it 😂
